<module id="radix2_div">
    <description>A simplified radix-2 divider for 8-bit signed or unsigned integers.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">The clock signal for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="rst">The reset signal to initialize or reset the module.</input>
        <input id="sign">Indicates if the operation is signed (1) or unsigned (0).</input>
        <input id="dividend" width_description="[7:0]">The dividend for division.</input>
        <input id="divisor" width_description="[7:0]">The divisor for division.</input>
        <input id="opn_valid">A valid operation request.</input>
        <output id="res_valid">The result is valid and ready.</output>
        <output id="result" width_description="[15:0]">The output containing the remainder in the upper 8 bits and the quotient in the lower 8 bits.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="DIVIDEND_WIDTH">8</parameter>
        <parameter id="DIVISOR_WIDTH">8</parameter>
        <parameter id="RESULT_WIDTH">16</parameter>
        <parameter id="COUNTER_WIDTH">4</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">

        <reg id="result_reg" width_description="[15:0]">Stores the result of the division.</reg>
        <reg id="res_valid_reg">Indicates if the result is valid and ready.</reg>
        <reg id="start_cnt">Starts the division process.</reg>
        <reg id="neg_divisor">Negates the divisor for subtraction.</reg>
        <reg id="carry_out">Carry-out signal for the subtraction.</reg>
        <reg id="sub_result">Subtraction result.</reg>
        <reg id="mux_out">Multiplexor output.</reg>
        <reg id="shift_in">Shift-in signal for the shift register.</reg>
        <reg id="sr_temp">Temporary variable for the shift register.</reg>
